entries.title: Foundations & Ethics
entries.summary: Perception, ethical regulation, and normative relationships.
entries.detail: Includes Perceptual Ethics and Regulative Ethics. These works are identified in the institution's public orientation; a dedicated public edition has not been verified.

entries.title: Systems & Dynamics
entries.summary: Cybernetics, recursion, paradox, and complex systems.
entries.detail: Includes Latticeal Cybernetics and Paradox Network Systems Theory. The listing identifies research directions, not verified downloadable publications.

entries.title: Architectonics & Knowledge Architecture
entries.summary: Structures of knowledge, cognition, and interfaces.
entries.detail: Encompasses Architectonics, Knowledge Architecture, Interface Architecture, Emotional Architecture, and Psychospatial Architecture as named in the public profile.

entries.title: Semantics, Poetics & Embodiment
entries.summary: Meaning, expression, interpretation, and aesthetic form.
entries.detail: Includes Field Semantics, Aesthetic Poetics, registers, and associated poetic work. Publication availability is not established here.

entries.title: Governance & Meta-Architecture
entries.detail: Research into governing architecture, recursive governance, institutes, and institutions. This directory is not a governing authority.
